Given this is a sub-processed test file, not using @testsets avoids leaking the report print into the Base test runner report Pass inbounds meta to getindex on CartesianIndices (#42115)
Test that --check-bounds=off doesn't permit const prop of indices into function that are not dynamically reachable (the same test for @inbounds is in the compiler tests).

Inbounds here assumes that this is only ever called with n==0, but of course the compiler has no way of knowing that, so it must not attempt to run the @inbounds `getfield(sin, 1)`` that ntuple generates.
